about:
Unicomp GA LLC operates from Lexington, Kentucky, where it manufactures the original buckling-spring "Model M" keyboard. The company traces its lineage to 25 years of production for IBM, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. No founder names or ownership structure are publicly stated.

The firm produces a range of clicky keyboards—including the New Model M, Mini M, SpaceSaver M, and a Mac variant—using new tooling at its Kentucky facility. It maintains a catalog of over 2,000 keyboard variations and offers a configurator tool that lets customers specify language layouts, colors, and features for build-to-order units. Stocked bestsellers are shipped directly from inventory.

Unicomp's customer base includes IBM, which sourced the buckling-spring design for decades, along with thousands of individual users worldwide. The keyboards are marketed to data-entry professionals and enthusiasts who prefer the tactile feedback of the original Model M design.

The company positions itself as the sole source of the authentic Model M, emphasizing that its buckling-spring mechanism is not an imitation but the original technology refined over 25 years. Custom configurations are manufactured on demand in Lexington, distinguishing it from resellers of third-party clones.
